description: This file contains unit tests for the feishu card interaction decoder, verifying its ability to correctly interpret different payload formats (structured, legacy, malformed, outdated, or contextually invalid). It imports functions from './card-interaction.js' and uses the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: buildFeishuCardActionTextFallback
methods.description: Generates fallback text for legacy payloads based on operator, context, and action data.

methods.name: createFeishuCardInteractionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates an interaction envelope object with specified parameters 'k', 'a', 'q', and 'c'.

methods.name: decodeFeishuCardAction
methods.description: Decodes a payload into a structured, legacy, or invalid form based on its structure and contents.
